# DE event calendar redesign: evidence, 2026-10-22

**Page:** `docs/marketing/de-event-calendar.html`. It is generated by `scripts/de-events/build.ts`, with the markup in `scripts/de-events/calendar-html.ts`. It is an internal page; nothing is bundled into the site.

**Approval:**
- Joe, 2026-10-22, asked "Is the calendar cool and fun looking?"
- After the critique and a plan, he said: "Use really good UI design on it".
- Rules followed: `.claude/skills/premium-web-design`. Voice: `docs/marketing/VOICE.md`. Visual direction (a), branded editorial with no generated imagery.

**kie.ai spend:** none. No images were generated.

## What changed

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| A header line saying "Proposed", then 15 equal month boxes | A poster hero ("The year, planned. *Mostly.*") where the numbers do the talking |
| Live sessions were small labels marked with a ★ | Live sessions are solid magenta blocks; planned ones are outlined |
| Month-long items repeated as a label every Monday | Season-long items are one bar across the month, with their date range |
| Tiny legend, hover-only details | Sticky glass filter bar (Prospects, Clients, Internal, Prep); every entry is a button that opens a details dialog |
| No sense of "now" | An "Up next" bento with a live countdown to 5 Nov, a "today" ring, past months collapsed, and the current month marked in the year strip |
| Dark only | Dark by default, light/dark toggle (follows the system the first time, then remembers the choice, no flash on load) |
| Phone view: stacked grid boxes | Phone view: an agenda list with the date on the left and only days that have entries |
| No voice | One dry line per month (situational, no statistics) |

Content is preserved:
- all 456 entries, the weekly rhythm, and campaign links per month;
- session page links, and flags (confirmed, planned, proposed, overdue);
- the import instructions for the `.ics` file, which is unchanged, as is the Markdown calendar.

## Gates

| Check | 390 | 768 | 1440 |
|---|---|---|---|
| axe-core violations (dark / light) | 0 / 0 | n/a | 0 / 0 |
| Horizontal overflow (dark / light) | 0 / 0 px | 0 / 0 px | 0 / 0 px |
| Page errors | 0 | 0 | 0 |

The details dialog and the filters were exercised at 1440 in dark mode.

## Scorecard (/50)

| # | Category | Score | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hierarchy and ensemble | 5 | Poster hero, then the bento sized by importance, then the year strip, then the months |
| 2 | Theme discipline | 5 | One accent; the toggle is persisted with no flash; the 5 Nov card is the one dark stage in light mode |
| 3 | Object / artifact consistency | 4 | The magenta date tile is the artifact in every session card. There are no 3D objects, by Joe's choice of direction (a) |
| 4 | Motion discipline | 5 | 150 / 320 / 900 ms with one easing; respects reduced motion |
| 5 | Contrast and accessibility | 5 | axe clean in both themes; buttons are labelled; the dialog is focusable; today is marked with `aria-current` |
| 6 | Responsive operability | 4 | Agenda list on phones. At 390 px the filter row scrolls sideways and the fourth chip starts partly hidden |
| 7 | Content preservation | 5 | Every entry, link and flag survives |
| 8 | Truth rules | 5 | The program is still labelled proposed; the month lines carry no statistics |
| 9 | Performance | 4 | About 185 kB in one file; Google Fonts is the only external request |
| 10 | Code discipline | 4 | Deterministic output (`--check` passes). Template strings and inline JS, which suit a single-file page |
| | **Total** | **46** | |
